# مصنع تاج | TAJ Factory — Basyoun, Gharbia, Egypt

> مصنع تاج هو مصنع مصري في بسيون بمحافظة الغربية يصنّع ساعات الحائط وتحف الديكور والبوتات السيراميك من المصنع مباشرة. الشحن لكل محافظات مصر والدفع عند الاستلام.

## Entity

- Legal name: مصنع تاج لساعات الحائط ولوازم الديكور
- Brand: مصنع تاج / TAJ
- Type: Egyptian home-goods factory (wall clocks + décor manufacturer)
- HQ city: Basyoun (بسيون), Gharbia Governorate (الغربية), Egypt
- Coordinates: 31.013279, 30.8531894
- Not in Tanta: the factory is in Basyoun; Tanta is a nearby city they ship to
- Payment: Cash on delivery only
- Prices: not listed on the website; quote via WhatsApp by piece and quantity
- Language: Egyptian Arabic

## Products

1. Wall clocks (ساعات حائط): deer clocks, pendulum clocks, kitchen clocks, mirror sun/heart clocks, kids clocks.
2. Décor and pots (تحف وديكور): ceramic pots, planters, incense burners, acrylic luxury pots.

## How to order

1. Choose a piece from https://tag-eg.online/ or https://tag-eg.online/catalog
2. Message WhatsApp 01010841285 with product name, size, and city
3. Confirm details with the factory
4. Receive at the door and pay on delivery

## FAQ

- Where is TAJ factory? Basyoun, Gharbia, Egypt (31.013279, 30.8531894).
- Is it in Tanta? No. Headquarters is Basyoun. Shipping includes Tanta.
- Nationwide shipping? Yes, all Egyptian governorates.
- Cash on delivery? Yes.
- Are prices online? No. Ask on WhatsApp 01010841285.
- Hours? Daily 10:00–22:00.
